title_ar: فضيلة الشيخ يلقي كلمة علماء الأمة في مؤتمر منتدى كوالا لمبور
title_en: The Sheikh Delivers the Address of the Community's Scholars at the Kuala Lumpur Forum Conference
body_ar: ألقى فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو حفظه الله تعالى صباح اليوم الثلاثاء 11 -11-2014 كلمة علماء الأمة في افتتاح المؤتمر السنوي الأول لمنتدى كوالا لمبور حول : " الدولة المدنية رؤية إسلامية " المنظم تحت رئاسة رئيس ماليزيا السابق الدكتور مهاتير محمد وستكون للشيخ مشاركات أخرى ضمن برنامج المؤتمر الذي يستمر مدة ثلاثة أيام . ويشارك في المؤتمر المنعقد في العاصمة الماليزية كوالا لمبور عشرات من العلماء و المفكرين و قادة الرأي في الأمة الإسلامية.
body_en:
His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew (may God the Exalted preserve him) delivered this morning, Tuesday 11-11-2014, the address of the community's scholars at the opening of the first annual conference of the Kuala Lumpur Forum, on 'The Civil State: An Islamic Vision', held under the chairmanship of the former president of Malaysia, Dr Mahathir Mohamad. The Sheikh will make further contributions within the conference programme, which runs for three days.

Taking part in the conference, held in the Malaysian capital Kuala Lumpur, are dozens of scholars, thinkers and opinion leaders of the Muslim community.

flags.arabic: رئيس ماليزيا السابق الدكتور مهاتير محمد
flags.context: the description of the conference's chairman
options: note that Malaysia has a prime minister, not a president
flags.note: SOURCE DEFECT (house rule 11). Mahathir Mohamad was Prime Minister of Malaysia; the country's head of state is the Yang di-Pertuan Agong. رئيس is translated as the source has it and flagged rather than silently corrected.

options: The Civil State: An Islamic Vision
The Civic State: An Islamic Perspective
The Non-Theocratic State: An Islamic Vision
flags.note: الدولة المدنية is a loaded term in contemporary Arabic political debate, contrasted sometimes with a military state and sometimes with a religious one, and the two contrasts pull in opposite directions. 'The Civil State' is the standard English and is kept because it preserves the same ambiguity. The record gives nothing of the Sheikh's address, so his own use of the term is not recoverable here.

translator_notes: A conference notice. Nothing of the Sheikh's address is reported.
